actions.action: Check soil moisture with finger 2-3 cm deep and lift pot to judge weight
Check for soggy roots signs (wet soil days after watering, soft stem bases, cover pot without drainage)
If soggy, tip plant out and inspect roots for brown mushy ones
Move plant 1-2 m back from window or behind a sheer blind
Water when top 2-3 cm dry until it drains, then empty saucer/cover pot
Alternatively set on wet pebble tray or use self-watering pot
Prune badly yellowed leaves at base after new leaves appear

reason: The answer names direct sun scorch as the main cause and its first fix is moving the plant out of direct sun, matching the thread; the watering advice is safeguarded by checking the soil first, so nothing is harmful.
